scope: Priority 0 is this thread's existing GBrain-inspired agent harness, conventional IDE and unified Lane5 ingress/egress commitments. Remaining phases are assigned post-local-completion integration and repair obligations, not a license to merge incomplete candidates.
priority_rule: No consolidation work may displace Priority 0 until its existing local thread contracts are implemented and evidence-complete; review/inventory work may proceed without diverting implementation.
mergeability_rule: All applicable checklist items require explicit evidence and PASS at the exact relevant SHA. OPEN is not PASS. A PR cannot be declared mergeable merely because a subset of scoped CI is green; preserve frozen layers and cumulative capabilities. A mandatory P8 forensic clearance gate additionally blocks P6.4 main merge and P7 production promotion, but does not displace P0 or earlier implementation work.
